youtube_description: After listening to Ariel's interview with Nick Diaz, I couldn't help but notice a handful of painfully obvious (and straight-up uncomfortable) signs that Nick is having a hard time dealing with Nate's rise to stardom. I found it particularly odd considering the godlike status Nate has attributed his brother to, and the fact that there haven't been any journalists or MMA media members that wanted to talk about this.
